messages:
devon: Quick heads-up — PR #7892 is ready for review but I can't merge until we get architecture sign-off. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7892

devon: TL;DR: changes routing for KV cache fallbacks and adds async prefetch. Touches Dedicated and Private routing policy. I linked the design doc below.

jessica: Can you paste the design doc link and a 1–2 line SLO/regression summary here? I need that before arch ack.

devon: design doc (draft): https://internal.redwood.dev/rfcs/478-kv-prefetch-routing — Summary: expected +2–5ms p95 in steady state; reduces tail under burst by avoiding sync cache stalls. Rollout plan in section 4 (canary + manual pause).

ali: I'll review the design doc this afternoon. @eric please confirm infra-side migrations (config flags, region rollout).

eric: infra note: no schema changes. We need a per-region feature flag and an ops checklist for cache warm-up during canary. No restart required. I'll add a small ops-runbook to the PR.

jessica: Skimmed the doc — looks promising but we need: (1) explicit failure-mode tests (simulate cache miss storm), (2) canary duration and metrics to watch (latency SLO, error rate, cache hit-rate). Add those to the PR and ping me again.

devon: On it. I'll add a test matrix (load profile + failure sim) and propose 2-week canary with daily checkpoint reviews. Pushing update in ~30m.

ci-bot: devon pushed 3 commits to feature/kv-prefetch (CI: all checks passed) :white_check_mark:

ali: I finished a quick pass on the doc; design-wise I'm 👍. Leaving final arch ack to @jessica after the test/canary details are in the PR.

jessica: Once the test matrix and canary section are in PR, I can give arch-approve. Please add an explicit rollback trigger threshold too.

devon: Thanks — adding rollback threshold and the test matrix now. Will update the PR description and tag you.

jessica: Thanks — ping me when updated and I'll re-review.

devon: Will do. Appreciate the quick alignment — trying to time this for next week's release window.
